name: copperpath
description: Route the open board or the selection with the copperpath autorouter; one Ctrl+Z undoes the route

actions.name: Route with copperpath
actions.description: Route all unrouted connections; existing copper stays as it is

actions.name: Route selected nets
actions.description: Route the nets of the selected tracks, vias, pads and footprints

actions.name: Route region
actions.description: Route the nets whose pads lie inside the selected rectangle or zone

actions.name: Rip up selected nets
actions.description: Remove the unlocked tracks and vias of the selected nets

actions.name: Rip up and reroute selected nets
actions.description: Remove the unlocked tracks and vias of the selected nets, then route them again
